title: Joining Amos Riley's orchestra and the Tulane brass band
summary: Older musicians like Dick Chambers and Amos Riley helped the boys; Riley chose him as drummer for his dance band and brass band, and he names the band members.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, I used to play with Tom Benton. Yeah, years ago, me and Tom played together. And so, getting back to the... Is that the telephone? No, no, I didn't hear my ring. Oh. And getting back to the old musicians came to us. Used to come to our rehearsal. Well, they used to come around, and they used to hear us, and they would help us out. And they would help us out. You know, it was a little, like, like, Dick Chambers, Amos Riley. All those old ones, at that time, used to come around. Mm-hm. You were talking Amos Riley. Well, Amos Riley picked me out to play drum in his orchestra. And that's the first good band I ever played with. And I joined Amos's band. And after I joined the orchestra, well, Amos put me in the brass band, which Amos had the brass band. Here at that time they called it the two-lane band.
Oh, yes, the two-lane band. The brass band. The brass band. Who was in the dance band with him when you played for dancers?
They had me, Amos was playing cornet, and we had Winnie's, Ellie on trombone, Charlie Moore.
Who was he playing?
No, on banjo, and we had Jimmy Johnson. The bass player?
Was he what?
No, no, not Jimmy Johnson. Alex Scott. On bass?
On bass. Did you have a clarinet player?
A clarinet, yeah, but Sam Dutry. Oh, yeah.
Which Sam Dutry is that? The young one?
No, the old man.
The old man.
The old man. The old man. Well, at that time, he had a young Sam, he was a little boy. The old man Sam.
Was that before Blind Freddy played with this band?
Huh?
Were you in there the same time as Blind Freddy?
No.
Never played with them. I just wonder if that was before or after Blind Freddy was with the Tulane band.
Well, that was afterwards.
It was afterwards that Blind Freddy came in.
No, before Blind Freddy.
